functions.kernelFunction: Storage market / miner / power / system / reward / datacap actors
functions.kernelValue: Storage market, miner, power and reward logic at protocol level. FIPs may propose modifications. Co-maintained by Lotus and Forest.

functions.kernelFunction: Distributed randomness beacon (threshold-BLS, League of Entropy)
functions.kernelValue: If the beacon stops, the chain halts instantly and (without months of R&D) irrecoverably. Governance and on-call support required.

functions.kernelFunction: FVM execution engine (deterministic WASM actor execution)
functions.kernelValue: Shared execution engine that produces gas spent; a divergence here forks execution across all clients. Co-maintained by Lotus and Forest.

functions.kernelFunction: GossipSub propagation, Kademlia DHT peer/content discovery, transports (TCP/QUIC) + NAT traversal
functions.kernelValue: Blocks must propagate within ~30s; precondition for propagation, discovery and every connection - failure threatens consensus.

functions.kernelFunction: Proving subsystem - PoRep (StackedDRG sealing), WinningPoSt/WindowPoSt, crypto primitives (BLST, bellperson, neptune)
functions.kernelValue: Storage proofs make physical storage trustless and gate block production and sector onboarding; a regression halts proving network-wide.

functions.kernelFunction: Block production - WinningPoSt leader election & block assembly
functions.kernelValue: Without miners running WinningPoSt there is no block production; the chain stops advancing. Majority of block producers run this (70%+).

functions.kernelFunction: Operation of seed nodes a new peer contacts on startup
functions.kernelValue: Without reachable bootstrap nodes a fresh node 'starts and just sits there'.

functions.kernelFunction: Chain sync & state management (snapshot bootstrap, heaviest-chain, RPC)
functions.kernelValue: A correct, fast sync path keeps nodes in consensus rather than forking. Read/write surface used by miners, wallets, explorers, RPC providers and FEVM dApps.

functions.kernelFunction: Consensus/validation client: fork-choice, state validation, message pool
functions.kernelValue: Most widely-deployed full node with broadest feature coverage; the client most of the network currently runs.

functions.kernelFunction: Deal-making + PDP + HTTP retrieval
functions.kernelValue: Composable deal interface and hot-storage proving - the demand-side onramp for SPs.

functions.kernelFunction: EVM + EAM actor
functions.kernelValue: Enables smart contract programmability. Requires keeping shared VM/actors/finality libraries consistent across clients through upgrades. Co-maintained by Lotus, Forest and Fil-B.

functions.kernelFunction: Independent Rust full node (sync, validation, RPC, snapshot export)
functions.kernelValue: Second production client bounds the blast radius of a Lotus bug - client diversity is a security property; ~30% lighter footprint, efficient snapshots, more performant Eth RPC.

functions.kernelFunction: Serving Groth16 trusted-setup parameters to every node and SP (go-paramfetch)
functions.kernelValue: The network cannot generate/verify proofs without these present and unaltered; impacts all nodes (verifiers) and miners (sealers and provers).

functions.kernelFunction: Proving scheduler - WindowPoSt deadlines + WinningPoSt eligibility
functions.kernelValue: Recurring liveness proofs and block production; missed windows mean fault penalties and power loss.

functions.kernelFunction: High-SLA HTTP + gossipsub relays & quarterly resharing
functions.kernelValue: Keeps randomness reachable and the threshold group healthy as members rotate. Infrastructure and on-call support required.

functions.kernelFunction: Sealing pipeline (PC1/PC2/Commit, SupraSeal, Snap)
functions.kernelValue: How SPs onboard committed capacity and data onto the network.

functions.kernelFunction: Validated snapshot generation & hosting (~2h cadence)
functions.kernelValue: New/recovering nodes cannot sync from genesis in reasonable time; fresh snapshots keep operators off bad forks. Forest produces them; Lotus can, with more resources.

functions.kernelFunction: Pooled block production (sophon-miner) + distributed sealing cluster (Damocles)
functions.kernelValue: Independent block-winning and sealing path for Venus SPs - SP-side client diversity. Dominant stack for China-based SPs (~15% of miners).

functions.kernelFunction: Explorer for Calibration testnet
functions.kernelValue: Supports rehearsal and analysis (need at least one).

functions.kernelFunction: Calibnet miners (Lotus-Miner / Curio / Venus) for upgrade rehearsal
functions.kernelValue: Makes Calibnet a faithful rehearsal; degraded coverage if missing.

functions.kernelFunction: Mainnet-realistic testnet for rehearsing every network-version upgrade
functions.kernelValue: Required rehearsal path that catches consensus-breaking issues before mainnet.

functions.kernelFunction: Vendor/access governance, runbooks, Slack/Workspace/GitHub stewardship
functions.kernelValue: Connective infra the ecosystem relies on; reduces systemic and key-person risk.

functions.kernelFunction: Monitoring, archival access and incident response (Grafana, OpsGenie, IR coordination)
functions.kernelValue: Observability and rapid response/recovery through upgrades and outages. Critical for network security; any provider can populate it.

functions.kernelFunction: Chain ETL and indexing
Chain ETL, indexing, normalization & parameter matching (BigQuery, Spacescope API)
functions.kernelValue: Free, vendor-neutral chain data anyone can reuse - no rebuilding their own pipeline.

functions.kernelFunction: Aggregates Filecoin on/off-chain data into open, queryable datasets and dashboards
functions.kernelValue: Prepares and presents network KPI metrics; free, vendor-neutral network data anyone can reuse - no rebuilding their own pipeline.

functions.kernelFunction: System to advertise CID content records
functions.kernelValue: An adopted solution for content routing is essential. The network doesn't halt, but it stops being a useful storage network.

functions.kernelFunction: Mainnet block explorer (Lotus archive, indexing, NV maintenance)
functions.kernelValue: Primary accessibility/observability surface for users and SPs.

functions.kernelFunction: Network-wide documentation along with source code availability and source control
functions.kernelValue: Onboarding to the ecosystem.

functions.kernelFunction: Technical program coordination, ecosystem technical support and discretionary grant administration across kernel teams
functions.kernelValue: The kernel is maintained by ~15 independent teams with no shared employer. Coordination is what sequences cross-team upgrades, gives SPs and integrators a support path, and funds gaps too small or too urgent for a funding round. Without it, gaps surface only when something breaks. Committee steward: Open Impact Foundation - FilPonto Cell (requirement public-goods-coordination-rpc-indexers-wallet-oracle).

functions.kernelFunction: Overcollateralized stablecoin settlement rail for storage and service payments (USDFC)
functions.kernelValue: Storage and retrieval priced in a volatile native token cannot be quoted or invoiced across a multi-month term; a stable unit of account on FVM is what lets paid storage, Filecoin Pay rails and onchain-cloud services be sold to enterprises. If it depegs or its liquidity dries up, onchain payments lose their unit of account. Committee steward: Secured Finance (requirement usdfc-overcollateralised-stablecoin).
